products.title: Scotty Cameron Compatible Red Large Thread Putter Weights
products.body_html:
CUSTOMIZE YOUR SCOTTY CAMERON PUTTER WITH RED WEIGHTS

Add a red weight option to a compatible Scotty Cameron putter while selecting the head weight that works for your setup. These Shaft Connect aftermarket replacement weights are made for select Scotty Cameron putters equipped with the large-thread weight design.

Each selection is sold as a pair and includes 2 matching red putter weights.

AVAILABLE WEIGHTS

Red large-thread weights are available in:

5g | 10g | 15g | 20g | 25g | 30g | 35g | 40g

Your selection includes 2 matching weights of the chosen gram weight. Both weights feature a red finish and 5-pin design.

COMPATIBLE WITH

These weights fit Scotty Cameron putters that use the large-thread, 5-pin weight design.

With the large number of Scotty Cameron models and generations produced over the years, model name alone is not a reliable way to confirm weight compatibility. Different thread sizes have been used, and there is no comprehensive published model-by-model fitment list.

Before purchasing, remove one of the weights currently installed in your putter. Check its thread size and compare it with the large-thread weight shown in the product images. Confirming the existing weight design is the best way to determine whether this replacement will fit your putter.

FINDING THE RIGHT WEIGHT FOR YOUR PUTTER

Choosing a different gram weight lets you change putter head weight while retaining a matching pair of sole weights. Golfers may choose a different weight because of a putter setup change, fitting preference, or simply because the original weights need to be replaced.

Different weight pairs can be useful for:

  • Increasing or decreasing head weight
  • Changing overall putter feel
  • Adjusting for a different playing length
  • Experimenting with different head-weight setups
  • Putter fitting and custom builds
  • Replacing missing or damaged weights

WEIGHT INSTALLATION & REMOVAL

A compatible Scotty Cameron-style putter weight tool is required to engage the 5-pin design when removing or installing these weights.

The putter weight tool is not included.

BUILD A CUSTOM WEIGHT KIT

Need more than one weight option? The Scotty Cameron Weight Kit lets you choose multiple weight pairs for fitting, experimentation, or different putter setups.

products.title: Scotty Cameron Compatible Putter Weight Black 5 Pin Wrench
products.body_html:
REMOVE & INSTALL SCOTTY CAMERON PUTTER WEIGHTS

This Shaft Connect aftermarket 5-pin wrench is designed for removing and installing compatible Scotty Cameron putter sole weights. Use it when replacing existing weights, changing putter head weight, or installing compatible aftermarket replacement weights.

The wrench features a black finish and a 5-pin design that engages the matching holes in compatible putter weights.

COMPATIBLE WITH

Designed for Scotty Cameron putter weights that use the 5-pin removal and installation pattern.

Scotty Cameron has produced many putter models and weight configurations over the years. Before use, confirm that your existing putter weights have the matching 5-pin pattern shown in the product images.

This wrench can be used with compatible original putter weights as well as Shaft Connect aftermarket Scotty Cameron compatible weights featuring the same 5-pin design.

HOW TO USE THE 5-PIN WEIGHT WRENCH

Position the wrench so all five pins are fully seated in the corresponding holes of the putter weight before applying turning force.

Some factory-installed putter weights can be difficult to remove. Applying hot water or gentle heat around the weight can sometimes help loosen the existing weight before removal. Avoid excessive heat that could damage the putter finish or surrounding components.

Once the weight is loosened, use the wrench to remove it. The same 5-pin wrench can then be used to install a compatible replacement weight.

Make sure all five pins are properly engaged with the weight before turning to reduce the chance of slipping or damaging the weight.
